$comment: Still frames of a capture page: one page, one seek per requested time, one image per time. Cheap review of a motion-graphics scene without encoding anything.
name: picture.stills
title: Picture stills
summary: Write still frames of an HTML page that exposes window.__motion (ready, seek(t), duration?, size?) as PNG or JPEG, at the times you ask for.
description: Serves the page over http from the workspace (plus /_mx/lib/... browser libraries), opens one browser page, and seeks to each requested time to write one image. Same page contract as picture.render: window.__motion = {ready: true, seek(t) -> void | Promise, duration?, size?: {width, height}}. Size comes from width/height or from window.__motion.size. Output names carry the time to three decimals, so a review folder can be read in order.

page.description: The HTML page to capture: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. It must set window.__motion = {ready: true, seek(t), duration?, size?}.

items.description: An HTML fragment file to splice into the page: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

inject.description: HTML fragments spliced into the page in order: at the first <!--mx:inject--> marker, else right before </body>.

globals.description: Window globals defined before the page scripts run: NAME -> any JSON value (written as window.NAME = ...). Names must be JS identifiers.

globals_files.description: Window globals read from JSON files: NAME -> a .json file (workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>). An entry in globals wins over the same name here.

query.description: Query string appended to the page URL (without the '?'), so a page can tell capture from preview.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels. Omit to use window.__motion.size.width.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Omit to use window.__motion.size.height.

times.description: Times in seconds (>= 0); one image is written per entry, named still-<t to 3 decimals>.<ext>.

format.description: Image format: png (lossless) or jpeg (smaller, quality applies). JPEG output uses the .jpg extension.

quality.description: JPEG quality when format is jpeg. Ignored for png.

offline.description: Block every request whose origin is not the local static server (fonts, CDNs, analytics); each block is recorded in page_errors.

device_scale_factor.description: Device pixel ratio of the browser context. Above 1 renders a page designed for CSS pixels at a higher pixel count.

warmup.description: Take and discard one cheap screenshot before the real stills. Headless Chromium stalls for about 15 s on a fresh page's first screenshot, so leave this on.

frame_timeout_s.description: How long one still (seek + screenshot) may take before it is retried.

frame_retries.description: Attempts per still; the page is re-seeked before every retry. All attempts failing fails the job.

ready_timeout_s.description: How long the page may take to set window.__motion.ready = true.

name.description: Output file name inside the job's out folder

stills.description: One entry per requested time, in request order

width.description: Image width in pixels (viewport width × device_scale_factor)

height.description: Image height in pixels (viewport height × device_scale_factor)

page_errors.description: Up to 50 unique page errors, console errors and blocked requests

examples.title: One still of a tiny page
